stages.journal: Ravna does not take a stranger's word, even a friendly stranger's. Ferrick keeps the Company's first ledger at the Tollhouse on the High Road; if the road knows you, he will say so. Get his voucher and the Captain will hear it.
Ferrick's word travels faster than boots. Back down to the Low Hall: Ravna seals the hand herself, and the charter towns will not love you better for wearing it.
